Simon — thanks for the files, they came through. Quick confirmation and next steps so we can stage the PO: 

1) What we received: W-9 (signed) and bank letter (PDF). Good start.

2) Verification options we can use (pick one):
   a) Notarized bank letter + photo ID matching the signer — fastest if you can get it notarized (we accept remote notarization).
   b) EIN OTP flow — we send a one-time verification PIN to the authorized signer by phone; the signer reads back the PIN and confirms on a short verification call. This is often quickest for U.S. entities and avoids a sealed notary.

3) Additional items we need to finalize onboarding:
   - Confirm legal entity name exactly as it appears on the W-9.
   - Confirm authorized signer name and best mobile number for OTP (if you choose option b).
   - Completed procurement_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (I attached a checklist with the fields we still need filled).

What happens after verification: once we complete the TIN/name verification (either route) procurement will stage the PO. Typical PO staging timeline is 2–3 business days after verification sign-off; if you need it faster we can escalate but we'll need approvals.

If you want the OTP flow, reply here with the signer name and a mobile number and I'll kick off the verification immediately.

Best,

Ben Carter
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0199
